EN:
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}{{TAG:000E:0003:}}{{TAG:0005:0008:}}, remember how I said
I was going to move?{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0027:}}Well, I've given it more thought,
and after telling a few others.{{TAG:0007:0000:05000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:05000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0001:}}
{{TAG:0003:000D:}}I've decided I can't bear to go!
I just love it here far too much!{{TAG:0007:0000:1E000000}}
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}So you'll be seeing me around town
just like always, {{TAG:0005:0007:}}.
ES:
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Ah, {{TAG:0005:0008:}}, ¿recuerdas que
tenía pensado mudarme?{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0027:}}Se lo comenté a otros vecinos y
me di cuenta de que me estaba
equivocando.{{TAG:0007:0000:05000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:05000000}}.
{{TAG:0003:000D:}}¡No puedo separarme de vosotros,
os quiero demasiado!{{TAG:0007:0000:1E000000}} Así que me
quedo, {{TAG:0005:0007:}}.
FR:
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}{{TAG:000E:0003:}}{{TAG:0005:0008:}},{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}} te souviens-tu que
j'avais dit que je comptais
déménager ?
{{TAG:0003:0027:}}En fait,{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}} depuis, {{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}j'y ai bien réfléchi,{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}
et j'en ai parlé à des amis{{TAG:0007:0000:05000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:05000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:05000000}}.{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:000D:}}Et je pense que je ne trouverai
jamais meilleur endroit où vivre.{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}
Alors je reste ici !
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}À très bientôt en ville donc,
{{TAG:0005:0007:}}.
IT:
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Salve, {{TAG:0005:0008:}}. Ricordi quando
ti ho detto che volevo andarmene?{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0027:}}Beh, ci ho pensato un po' su,
ho chiesto consiglio anche ad altri.{{TAG:0007:0000:05000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:05000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:05000000}}{{TAG:0007:0001:}}
{{TAG:0003:0026:}}E ho deciso di rimanere!
Non potrei vivere meglio in nessun
altro posto!{{TAG:0007:0000:1E000000}}{{TAG:0003:0025:}} Insomma, mi vedrai
in giro come sempre, {{TAG:0005:0007:}}.
DE:
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}{{TAG:000E:0003:}}{{TAG:0005:0008:}}! {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}Weißt du noch, als ich
von hier wegziehen wollte?{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0027:}}Nachdem ich diese Neuigkeit publik
gemacht hatte, ließ ich sie mir noch
einmal durch den Kopf gehen{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.
{{TAG:0003:000D:}}Und ich habe beschlossen, dass ich
unmöglich diesen schönen Ort
verlassen kann.
Es gefällt mir einfach zu gut hier.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Also wirst du mich auch in Zukunft
durch den Ort spazieren sehen!
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}{{TAG:000E:0003:}}{{TAG:0005:0008:}}, taşınacağımı söylediğimi
hatırlıyor musun?{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0027:}}Biraz daha düşündüm,
birkaç kişiye de
söyledikten sonra.{{TAG:0007:0000:05000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:05000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0001:}}
{{TAG:0003:000D:}}Gitmeye kıyamayacağıma karar verdim!
Burayı fazlasıyla seviyorum!{{TAG:0007:0000:1E000000}}
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Yani beni her zamanki gibi kasabada
görmeye devam edeceksin, {{TAG:0005:0007:}}.

EN:
{{TAG:0003:0027:}}{{TAG:000E:0003:}}{{TAG:0005:0008:}}, remember how I was
planning on moving away from
town, {{TAG:0005:0007:}}?
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}As it turns out, everyone was far
too upset when they heard the
news.{{TAG:0007:0000:05000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:05000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:05000000}} Especially {{TAG:0011:0000:0000}}.
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}So I've decided not to move.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}
Isn't that good news? We're still
going to be neighbors!
ES:
{{TAG:0003:0027:}}{{TAG:000E:0003:}}{{TAG:0005:0008:}}, ¿te acuerdas de que
iba a mudarme del pueblo,
{{TAG:0005:0007:}}?
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Todo el mundo se enfadó mucho
conmigo cuando se lo conté.{{TAG:0007:0000:05000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:05000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:05000000}}
sobre todo {{TAG:0011:0000:0000}}.
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Y después de mucho pensar,
he decidido quedarme.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} ¿No es
una buena noticia, cielín?
FR:
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Dis, {{TAG:0005:0008:}},{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} te souviens-tu que
je comptais déménager,
{{TAG:0005:0007:}} ?
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Mais puisque tous mes amis,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} et
{{TAG:0011:0000:0000}} en particulier,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} ont
insisté pour que je ne parte pas...
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}... tu seras ravi{{TAG:000E:0006:000002006500}} d'apprendre que
j'ai décidé de rester ici.
IT:
{{TAG:0003:0027:}}{{TAG:000E:0003:}}{{TAG:0005:0008:}}, ricordi che
avevo in mente di cambiare
città, {{TAG:0005:0007:}}?
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}A quanto pare, molta gente c'è
rimasta male quando l'ha saputo.{{TAG:0007:0000:05000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:05000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:05000000}}
soprattutto {{TAG:0011:0000:0000}}.
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}E così, alla fine ho deciso di restare.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}
Ottima notizia, vero?
Saremo ancora concittadin{{TAG:000E:0006:0200690002006500}}!
DE:
{{TAG:0003:0027:}}Erinnerst du dich noch an meinen
Plan, unseren schönen Ort hinter
mir zu lassen, {{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}{{TAG:0005:0008:}}?
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Als ich das publik machte, waren
unsere Nachbarn sehr aufgebracht{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}
Allen voran {{TAG:0011:0000:0000}}!
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Daher habe ich beschlossen, doch
noch eine Weile hierzubleiben.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}
Sind das nicht tolle Nachrichten?
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:0027:}}{{TAG:000E:0003:}}{{TAG:0005:0008:}}, hani kasabadan taşınmayı
planlıyordum, {{TAG:0005:0007:}}?
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Meğer haberi duyan herkes fena
üzülmüş.{{TAG:0007:0000:05000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:05000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:05000000}} Özellikle de {{TAG:0011:0000:0000}}.
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Ben de taşınmamaya karar verdim.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}
İyi haber, değil mi? Hâlâ komşuyuz!

EN:
{{TAG:0003:0027:}}Remember when I said I was moving
soon? {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}Well, {{TAG:0011:0000:0000}} told me not
to go.{{TAG:0007:0000:05000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:05000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:05000000}}so I'm not!
{{TAG:0003:001B:}}I didn't mean to cause a fuss, but
it's nice to know I'd be missed
if I left, {{TAG:0005:0007:}}.
{{TAG:0003:0009:}}Big news, right? You and I will still
be neighbors, {{TAG:0005:0008:}}!
ES:
{{TAG:0003:0027:}}Al final no me mudo, ¿sabes?{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}
Cuando se lo dije a {{TAG:0011:0000:0000}}, se
puso tan triste que me llegó al alma.
{{TAG:0003:001B:}}No quería armar tanto revuelo,{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}
pero es muy bonito saber que te
echarían de menos si te fueras.
{{TAG:0003:0009:}}En fin, ¡parece que seguiremos
siendo vecin{{TAG:000E:0006:02006F0002006100}}s, {{TAG:0005:0008:}}!
FR:
{{TAG:0003:0027:}}Te souviens-tu que je t'avais dit que
je quitterais bientôt la ville ?{{TAG:0000:0004:}}Eh bien {{TAG:0011:0000:0000}} a fini par me
convaincre de revenir sur ma
décision{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Je reste !
{{TAG:0003:0009:}}J'espère que tu en es ravi{{TAG:000E:0006:000002006500}}, toi
aussi, {{TAG:0005:0007:}}.
IT:
{{TAG:0003:0027:}}Avevo detto che presto me ne sarei
andata, ricordi? {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}Beh, {{TAG:0011:0000:0000}}
mi ha fatto cambiare idea!
{{TAG:0003:001B:}}Non volevo confonderti le idee.
Però fa piacere sapere che sarei
mancata a qualcuno, {{TAG:0005:0007:}}.
{{TAG:0003:0009:}}Insomma, una grande notizia, no?
Potremo continuare a vederci,
{{TAG:0005:0008:}}!
DE:
{{TAG:0003:0027:}}Weißt du noch, damals, {{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}als ich
vorhatte, von hier wegzuziehen?{{TAG:0000:0004:}}Nun,{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} {{TAG:0011:0000:0000}} bat mich, nicht
zu gehen{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Also bleibe ich noch.{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:001B:}}Schließlich will ich niemandem das
Herz brechen, {{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}} Aber
es ist schön, geschätzt zu werden!
{{TAG:0003:0009:}}Ich hoffe, du bist auch erfreut, dass
wir weiterhin Nachbarn bleiben,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}
{{TAG:0005:0008:}}!
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:0027:}}Hani yakında taşınacağımı söylemiştim? {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}Şey,
{{TAG:0011:0000:0000}} gitmememi söyledi.{{TAG:0007:0000:05000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:05000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:05000000}}ben de gitmiyorum!
{{TAG:0003:001B:}}Böyle tantana çıkarmak istememiştim ama

{{TAG:0003:0009:}}Büyük haber, değil mi? Seninle hâlâ

status of my big move. {{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}How many
days and all that, right?
Well, guess what? {{TAG:0007:0001:}}{{TAG:0003:0025:}}I'm NOT moving.{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}
Yes, {{TAG:0011:0000:0000}} was kind enough
to say how much {{TAG:000E:0008:00CD080068006500270064000A007300680065002700640002003000}} miss me!
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Wasn't that nice? Now we'll be
neighbors for a lot longer.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}
Who knows? {{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}Maybe forever!
ES:
{{TAG:0003:0027:}}Seguro que te estás preguntando
cuándo me mudo, ¿verdad? {{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}
¿Pues sabes qué? {{TAG:0007:0001:}}{{TAG:0003:0025:}}¡Me quedo!{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}
¡{{TAG:000E:0003:}}{{TAG:0011:0000:0000}} fue tan dulce al
decirme que me echaría de menos,
que no puedo hacerle algo así!
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Podremos seguir viéndonos todos
los días. {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}¿Verdad que te alegras?
FR:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Je ne pars plus, {{TAG:0005:0008:}} ! {{TAG:0007:0000:1E000000}}Je
t'avais dit l'autre jour que je
comptais déménager...
... {{TAG:0003:0025:}}mais j'ai changé d'avis, {{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}depuis.{{TAG:0007:0000:1E000000}}

{{TAG:0003:0001:}}N'est-ce pas une plutôt bonne

{{TAG:0003:0027:}}Ti starai chiedendo come va
il trasloco. {{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}Quanti giorni

Beh, sai che c'è di nuovo? {{TAG:0007:0001:}}{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Resto qui.{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}

che {{TAG:000E:0008:00CD060067006C00690004006C00650002003000}} sarei mancata molto...
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Non potevo certo deluderl{{TAG:000E:0008:00CD02006F000200610002003000}}! Credo
